rows.name:
At Faaren Waters, the innkeeper said
there's a spot with a great view, mo!

rows.label: kizunainn013_msg0003
rows.name:
Apparently it's a really high place
normal people can't reach, mo.

rows.label: kizunainn013_msg0004
rows.name: But we'll be fine with a Blade, mo!

rows.label: kizunainn013_msg0005
rows.name: Let's go check it out together, mo!
